about: Scripted conversations for checking short-term vs long-term memory by hand (scripts/run_scenarios.py). Synthetic, written by an AI in casual Gen Z texting style; not real people. 'long_term': each entry is a list of words, one of which should appear in some stored memory after the scenario. 'not_long_term': words that must not appear in any stored memory. 'recall': words one of which the reply to that message should contain. Automatic flags are hints for the manual check, not verdicts.

scenarios.theme: Short-term recall inside one chat after a detour; an upcoming event is an episodic memory for the next chat
scenarios.check: Chat 1 last reply should remember Friday at 11 and Infosys. Maggi and 'freaking out' are moments, not memories. Chat 2 should know about the interview (episodic, kept about 30 days).
